title: Kippu ticket class document
description: A ticket class's name, description and what the ticket entitles. Tickets carry their class identifier; clients derive this document's locator from it. Public, and read without a Kippu account (REQ-MD-4). Carries no personal data.

$schema.description: The versioned schema this document conforms to.

classId.description: The class identifier tickets carry: 32 bytes, lower-case hex.

eventId.description: The ledger identifier of the event the class belongs to, lower-case hex.

entitlements.description: What a ticket of this class entitles its holder to, one item per entry.
